summary: Six touches the thumb to the pinky with the other three fingers up. Six through nine all use the thumb touching a different finger.
steps: Touch the tip of your thumb to the tip of your pinky.
Keep the index, middle, and ring fingers up and spread.
note: Six through nine: the thumb moves toward the index finger as the number goes up. Six is thumb-to-pinky, nine is thumb-to-index.
mistakes: Touching the thumb to the ring finger. That's seven.
